{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Socialists will implement a sweeping minimum program immediately upon taking power to cement working class political rule.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Socialists will destroy every institution that denies the people an authentic popular democracy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Senate will be abolished.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Electoral College will be abolished.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court will be abolished.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The independent presidency will be abolished.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Direct, universal, and equal suffrage will be implemented.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Supreme power will rest in the hands of a popular, unicameral assembly elected by proportional representation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Delegates to the popular assembly will be recallable at any time.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Delegates to the popular assembly will receive no more than a skilled worker’s wage.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All parties that accept the laws of the new revolutionary order will be free to operate.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Local organs of government will have a wide degree of autonomy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unrestricted freedom of speech will be guaranteed to all.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The republic will launch social programs of targeted wealth redistribution to make good on the unfulfilled promise of Reconstruction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The republic will strive to eliminate all racial inequalities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The socialist republic will put political power and economic resources into the hands of all racially oppressed and colonized people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
